src/main/java/ProcessingReport.java:
- public final class ProcessingReport
  - private int rowsRead, rowsKept, rowsWritten initialized to 0.
  - private LinkedHashMap<String,Integer> invalidCounts initialized empty.
  - public ProcessingReport()
  - public void incrementRowsRead(): increments rowsRead by exactly 1.
  - public void incrementRowsKept(): increments rowsKept by exactly 1.
  - public void incrementRowsWritten(): increments rowsWritten by exactly 1.
  - public void recordInvalid(String column): adds 1 to invalidCounts for key column exactly once per call; must not increment other counters.
  - public int getRowsRead(), getRowsKept(), getRowsWritten(): return respective counters.
  - public LinkedHashMap<String,Integer> invalidCounts(): returns an unmodifiable defensive copy preserving insertion order. No method changes unrelated counters.

src/main/java/Cell.java:
- public final class Cell
  - private final String raw.
  - public static Cell of(String raw): if raw==null, store empty string; else store raw as-is.
  - public String raw(): returns stored raw.
  - public boolean isBlank(): returns raw.trim().isEmpty(). Immutable; no setters.

src/main/java/Row.java:
- public final class Row
  - private final List<String> header; private final List<Cell> cells; both copied defensively in constructor.
  - public Row(List<String> header, List<Cell> cells): copies inputs and may pad internal cells to header size using Cell.of("") if needed.
  - public List<String> header(): returns unmodifiable defensive copy or unmodifiable view that cannot be mutated by caller.
  - public List<Cell> cells(): returns unmodifiable defensive view of cells list.
  - public Cell get(String column): finds first index i in header with header.get(i).equals(column); if found and i < cells.size(), return cells.get(i); if not found or i>=cells.size(), return Cell.of("").
  - public LinkedHashMap<String,String> asStringMap(): builds an ordered map of header->cells[i].raw() for each header index; if cells shorter, empty string for missing.

src/main/java/Sorters.java:
- public final class Sorters
  - public static final class Order
    - private final String column; private final boolean ascending.
    - public Order(String column, boolean ascending)
    - public String column(): returns column.
    - public boolean ascending(): returns ascending.
  - public static Comparator<Row> comparator(List<Order> orders): returns a comparator that for each Order compares the corresponding Cell.raw() strings; blanks (cell.isBlank()) always sort after non-blanks regardless of ascending/descending; for non-blank comparisons use String.compareTo; apply ascending flag by reversing sign if needed; if tie across all orders, deterministically tie-break by comparing full Row as concatenated raw strings (e.g., iterate header order) to avoid nondeterminism; never use Java streams.

src/main/java/Sheet.java:
- public final class Sheet
  - private final String name; private final List<String> header; private final List<Row> rows.
  - public Sheet(String name, List<String> header, List<Row> rows): copies inputs defensively.
  - public String name(): returns name.
  - public List<String> header(): unmodifiable defensive header view.
  - public List<Row> rows(): unmodifiable defensive rows view.
  - public Sheet filter(Predicate<Row> predicate, ProcessingReport report): builds a new Sheet with only rows where predicate.test(row) is true; for each retained row, call report.incrementRowsKept() exactly once; does not change report.rowsRead or rowsWritten; header/name preserved.
  - public Sheet sort(List<Sorters.Order> orders): returns a new Sheet with rows sorted by Sorters.comparator(orders); no counter changes.

src/main/java/ValueParser.java:
- public final class ValueParser
  - public static Double toDouble(String raw, String column, ProcessingReport report): if raw==null or raw.trim().isEmpty(), return null without recording; else attempt Double.valueOf(trimmed); on NumberFormatException, call report.recordInvalid(column) exactly once and return null.

src/main/java/Filters.java:
- public final class Filters
  - public static Predicate<Row> equals(String column, String value): returns predicate evaluating row.get(column).raw().equals(value).
  - public static Predicate<Row> contains(String column, String fragment): returns predicate evaluating row.get(column).raw().contains(fragment).
  - public static Predicate<Row> numericGreaterThan(String column, double threshold, ProcessingReport report): for a given row, call ValueParser.toDouble once with row.get(column).raw(); if null return false; else return parsed > threshold.

src/main/java/Aggregations.java:
- public final class Aggregations
  - public static int count(Sheet sheet): returns sheet.rows().size().
  - public static double sum(Sheet sheet, String column, ProcessingReport report): iterate rows once, call ValueParser.toDouble once per row; accumulate non-null values; ignore blanks/invalids; return 0.0 if none.
  - public static double average(Sheet sheet, String column, ProcessingReport report): as sum but divide by count of numeric values; return 0.0 if no numeric values.
  - public static Double min(Sheet sheet, String column, ProcessingReport report): iterate once, call ValueParser once per row; track smallest non-null; return null if none.
  - public static Double max(Sheet sheet, String column, ProcessingReport report): iterate once, call ValueParser once per row; track largest non-null; return null if none.
  - All methods must not use Java streams; use for loops and ArrayList.

src/main/java/CsvIO.java:
- public final class CsvIO
  - public static Sheet importCsvFromString(String name, String csv, ProcessingReport report): split by '\n' retaining order; first line is header split by ',' with negative limit to preserve trailing empties; for each subsequent line (data row), split with negative limit; pad to header length with empty strings; ignore excess cells; construct Cell for each field; wrap in Row; increment report.incrementRowsRead() exactly once per data row; return new Sheet(name, header, dataRows).
  - public static String toCsvString(Sheet sheet, ProcessingReport report): build string with header line (comma-joined) followed by each row as comma-joined cell.raw(); for every data row written, call report.incrementRowsWritten() exactly once; must not modify rowsRead or rowsKept; use '\n' line separators; do not quote commas or escape.
